parallelActionPages.actionCapacity: optional integer 1..4; absent means one legacy page
parallelActionPages.availableActionSlots: optional integer 0..4; capacity is not authentication authority
parallelActionPages.activeActionIds: optional list of at most four opaque action IDs; accepted and uncertain actions retain page ownership
parallelActionPages.readyHealth: GET /v1/health?ready=1 awaits fresh idle-page session proof; ordinary health remains bounded and passive
parallelActionPages.ordering: one action per canonical conversation; maintenance drains all page lanes; global HTTP429 and actual Send spacing remain shared

newChat.destination: configured ChatGPT project or top-level new chat
newChat.completion: confirmed new conversation URL after Send acceptance

accountPlan.cache: cache verified nonempty plans per server epoch and account; retry a basic Pro fallback after 60 seconds to resolve its billing tier
accountPlan.restoration: a conversation-loading cooldown may defer restoring the shared tab but must not discard an already verified plan; it never bypasses the global navigation budget

connectorRefresh.completion: observed refresh control busy/idle cycle and Allow all tools selected
connectorRefresh.ownership: exclusive shared browser transaction through preparation, confirmation and original-page restoration; other browser UI operations wait

pairingWindowReservation.scope: Successful re-pairing CreateChat submissions retain the shared window for one matching continuation; account, canonical URL, connector and pairing generation must match
pairingWindowReservation.expiry: Timeout, cancellation, superseded pairing or shutdown releases the window without replaying the initialization message

browserPromptTicket.scope: Host-issued single-use ticket for this task owner; new-conversation initialization may bootstrap setup on an empty chain before continue_task claims the task
browserPromptTicket.redemption: First ticketed call waits for any preceding in-flight call, then advances the normal ticket chain; all later calls use the returned new_codexify_ticket
browserPromptTicket.issuance: Fresh for each new browser message action, including initialization, retries and renewal; transport retries retain the admitted request unchanged

responseStop.preparation: offline chat and goal actions inspect Stop and its exact confirmation before composer cleanup, model selection, connector selection and prompt insertion; a late confirmation permits one retry of the interrupted pre-Send step
responseStop.ownership: confirm only in the verified paired conversation and account; never retry Send or reload an open confirmation

conversationApproval.scope: Current verified conversation and its configured connector only; no navigation or message submission
conversationApproval.policy: Core calls only while autoApproveToolCalls is enabled; checks yield to browser actions

navigationDeferral.availability: Read-only POST /v1/navigation/availability accepts a ChatGPT url and returns protocolVersion, build and nullable availableAtMs without navigating; reusing the current conversation requires no load
navigationDeferral.policy: A local cooldown prevents navigation without failing the action or consuming a retry. The core queues the action until the deadline and releases the shared browser. HTTP 429 received after a real request remains a failure.

executeOptionalFields.bypassConversationCooldown: boolean, default false; explicit owner Retry only. Bypasses local conversation-load, access-error and HTTP cooldown checks for this action. Account, ownership and Send checks remain required; loads still reserve the next automatic cooldown.

launchConfiguration.requestBlockList: CODEXIFY_BROWSER_REQUEST_BLOCK_LIST: JSON array of RE2 URL patterns; verified browser-wide before navigation

conversationLimitRecovery.detection: A visible ChatGPT conversation-length alert outside user or assistant message content; verify the same account and requested conversation before reporting it.
conversationLimitRecovery.recovery: Do not retry Send in the exhausted conversation. Create one replacement in the configured project, use continue_task and pairing verification, and retain the existing task workspace, history, goals and unread message cursor.
conversationLimitRecovery.acceptance: A confirmed conversation-length rejection retains its typed cause even after transport Send acceptance; uncertain sends without that rejection remain ambiguous.
conversationLimitRecovery.ownership: Pair the next task owner only; source activity must not revoke its pending creation. Retire the old conversation only after the one-time continuation claim.

turnRenewal.completionProof: Same account and conversation; latest assistant final begins with the exact handoff ID, has completion controls, no generation and stable content across two observations. Rechecked before continuation Send.
turnRenewal.sendClock: First confirmed Send acceptance, actual selected model and effort; pairing sends excluded.

actionAdmission.receipt: Record and acknowledge a queued action before waiting for browser ownership or account preflight; Send is not accepted by admission.
actionAdmission.reconciliation: Idempotent execute and action status remain available during preflight; preflight failures and cancellation are retained unsent terminal events.
actionAdmission.ownership: One admitted action at a time; preflight waits behind earlier browser maintenance, verifies account and idle state before execution, and outlives the receipt connection.

modelPickerInspection.modelOptions: Discovery, model selection and pairing expose the composer-owned model submenu before requiring model radios, including lazily mounted inline or aria-controls-owned portal lists.
modelPickerInspection.control: Use a unique composer-owned semantic trigger, or a unique aria-controls trigger bearing a known localized effort label. Never infer model identity from an effort label.
modelPickerInspection.restoration: Inspection restores the effort view and verifies unchanged range and selection; pairing borrows localized Medium and restores the original model and effort.
modelPickerInspection.submenuOwnership: Read aria-controls after expansion and during hydration; a closed trigger need not publish its future portaled menu ID.
modelPickerInspection.clickability: Mounted model rows are not actionable inside a collapsed simple view or an inert/aria-hidden panel, even when they have layout boxes. Expand the owned model panel and verify active rows before selecting.

operationError.policy: Only controlled bounded picker failures carry structured messages. Unknown raw page/request failures remain generic. The core verifies protocol, build, code and stage before displaying a failure.
